subject: general
question: Rabindranath Tagore started Santiniketan institute in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1901.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore started Santiniketan Institute in the year 1901.**
 
• Santiniketan was initially started as a school for children, later it became Visva-Bharati University, which is a central university located in Santiniketan, West Bengal.
 
• The main objective of Santiniketan was to combine the best of the East and the West and to create a place of learning that would be free from the constraints of the traditional education system.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore believed in the concept of **"Shantiniketan" or "abode of peace",** which was reflected in the name of the institution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Rabindranath Tagore:

 
• He was the youngest son of Debendranath Tagore, a leader of the Brahmo Samaj.
 
• He was the first Indian to win a Nobel prize for literature.
 
• He is also referred to as 'The Bard of Bengal'.
 
• He wrote the anthem of two countries - Jana Gana Mana, the Indian anthem, and Amar Sonar Bangla or My Golden Bengal, the Bangladesh anthem.
